name: Daywise Invoices
query:
SELECT 
    b."posting_date" AS "Date",
    TO_CHAR(b."posting_time", 'HH12:MI AM') AS "Time",
    b."name" AS "Invoice:Link/POS Invoice",
    b."net_total" AS "Item Total",
    b."total_taxes_and_charges" AS "Total Taxes and Charges",
    b."grand_total" AS "Grand Total",
    (b."grand_total" - b."rounded_total") AS "Round Off",
    b."rounded_total" AS "Rounded Total",
    CASE WHEN b."customer_group" = 'Aggregators' THEN 0 ELSE b."paid_amount" END AS "Received Amount",
    CASE WHEN b."customer_group" = 'Aggregators' THEN 0 ELSE b."change_amount" END AS "Change Amount",
    COALESCE(
    CASE 
        WHEN b."rounded_total" > 0 THEN (b."rounded_total" - b."paid_amount" + b."change_amount")
        ELSE (b."grand_total" - b."paid_amount" + b."change_amount")
    END, 
    0
    ) AS "Cash Discounts",
    STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN c."amount" != 0 THEN c."mode_of_payment" END, ', ' ORDER BY c."amount") AS "Payment Mode"
FROM generate_series(%(start_date)s::date, %(end_date)s::date, interval '1 day') AS date_list(date)
LEFT JOIN "tabPOS Invoice" b ON (
    b."branch" = %(branch)s
    AND b."status" IN ('Consolidated','Paid') 
    AND b."docstatus" = 1
)
LEFT JOIN "tabSales Invoice Payment" c ON (
    c."parent"= b."name"
)
LEFT JOIN "tabURY Report Settings" rs ON (
    rs."branch" = %(branch)s
)
WHERE
    (
    ((rs."hours" IS NULL OR rs."hours" = 0) AND b."posting_date" = date_list."date")
    OR (rs."hours" > 0 AND (b."posting_date" + b."posting_time") <= (date_list."date" + interval '1 day' + make_interval(hours => rs."hours"::integer)) AND (b."posting_date" + b."posting_time") >= (date_list."date" + make_interval(hours => rs."hours"::integer)))
    OR (rs."branch" IS NULL AND b."posting_date" = date_list."date")
    )
GROUP BY 
    date_list."date",b."name"
ORDER BY 
    date_list."date" ASC, b."name" ASC
